sloka: न ददर्श प्रियां राजा कैकेयीं शयनोत्तमे ।स कामबलसंयुक्तो रत्यर्थं मनुजाधिपः ॥२-१०-१७॥
transliteration: na dadarśa priyāṁ rājā kaikeyīṁ śayanottame ।sa kāmabalasaṁyukto ratyarthaṁ manujādhipaḥ ॥2-10-17॥

translations.english: Charged with passion and seeking carnal pleasure, the king became dejected when he did not see his beloved wife. He enquired about her.
translations.hindi: जसे पापसङ्कसपे रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्‌ । ` Bie PA ग्रभांतकाल नहीं चाहता
